dogecoin.text:
A bit of a syllogism.

Money is just a symbolic representation system.

So is a meme.

Money, is a kind of meme.

There's USD money memes, ¥ money memes, Dogecoin money memes.

Get *beyond* money and get to symbolic representation.

Then you get computing, fundamentally.
